desc:
Welcome to Boxing For Brainrots!🥊

1. Box the Boss down and break the Wall!
2. Smash through Walls and grab Brainrots!
3. Watch out for the Swim wave — don't get caught!
4. Your Brainrots earn Cash automatically, even offline!
5. Train your Punch Strength to KO tougher Bosses! 💪

👍 LIKE the game if you're having fun!
🔔 Join the group for free rewards and updates!
